text.p: Australian gaming machine manufacturer Aristocrat Leisure Ltd said on Tuesday it has won further orders from casinos in Sydney and Melbourne.

An additional order by Sydney's Star City Casino, operated by Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd, has increased Aristrocrat's share of the total number of gaming machines in Sydney to 63 percent from 56 percent. It said it will supply 938 of the casino's 1,500 machines.
In Melbourne, Aristocrat said its share of the market has increased to 49 percent from 44 percent through an order by Crown Ltd, representing a total of 1,230 machines.

Aristocrat state manager Greg France said; "We have developed an excellent working relationship with Crown Casino, and the outstanding performance of our machines in the permanent casino has led to the strengthening of that relationship."
Aristocrat's shares were suspended from trading on July 23 and reinstated July 31.
The suspension was enforced after a dispute with the Colorado Limited Gaming Control Commission over the Commission's denial of a renewal of Aristocrat's licence to operate in the U.S. state.
Shares hit a year low at A$2.50 when Aristocrat was reinstated. At 1.40 p.m. (0340 GMT), the shares were one cent higher at A$2.65.
